R3661.en: Online information sources can proliferate rapidly when barriers to publication are low.
R3661.zh: 当发布门槛较低时，在线信息源会迅速激增。

R3665.en: Regular physical activity can promote cardiovascular health and psychological well-being.
R3665.zh: 规律的体育活动可以促进心血管健康和心理健康。

R3667.en: A sudden rise in prices can prompt households to reduce non-essential consumption.
R3667.zh: 物价突然上涨会促使家庭减少非必需消费。

R3668.en: Learners often pronounce unfamiliar scientific terms more accurately after repeated exposure to spoken examples.
R3668.zh: 在反复接触口语示例之后，学习者往往能更准确地读出陌生的科学术语。

R3671.en: Falling technology costs have helped propel the rapid expansion of solar power.
R3671.zh: 技术成本的下降推动了太阳能的快速扩张。

R3677.en: The authors propose a model in which social and environmental factors interact over time.
R3677.zh: 作者提出了一个模型，其中社会因素与环境因素随着时间的推移相互作用。

R3684.en: Restoring coastal wetlands can protect communities from storm surges while supporting biodiversity.
R3684.zh: 恢复沿海湿地可以保护社区免受风暴潮侵袭，同时有助于维护生物多样性。

R3691.en: Longitudinal studies provide stronger evidence about change over time than single cross-sectional surveys.
R3691.zh: 与单次横断面调查相比，纵向研究能就随时间发生的变化提供更有力的证据。

R3706.en: Researchers are expected to publish methods clearly enough for other teams to evaluate the work.
R3706.zh: 研究人员应当把方法公布得足够清楚，以便其他团队能够评价其工作。

R3708.en: Regulatory systems may punish repeated non-compliance with fines or restrictions on operation.
R3708.zh: 监管体系可以对屡次违规行为处以罚款或限制其运营。

R3712.en: The observed change cannot be explained purely by economic factors.
R3712.zh: 所观察到的变化无法纯粹用经济因素来解释。

R3714.en: Natural wetlands can help purify water by trapping sediment and absorbing nutrients.
R3714.zh: 天然湿地可以通过截留沉积物和吸收养分来帮助净化水质。

R3715.en: Governments may pursue economic growth while also attempting to reduce carbon emissions.
R3715.zh: 政府可能在追求经济增长的同时努力减少碳排放。

R3716.en: Rapid urban growth can put considerable pressure on housing, transport and public services.
R3716.zh: 城市的快速增长会给住房、交通和公共服务带来相当大的压力。

R3721.en: Participants had to meet several criteria to qualify for inclusion in the clinical trial.
R3721.zh: 参与者必须满足若干标准，才有资格被纳入该临床试验。

R3726.en: The researchers used statistical models to quantify the effect of income on educational attainment.
R3726.zh: 研究人员使用统计模型来量化收入对教育程度的影响。

R3729.en: The relationship was assessed quantitatively using regression analysis.
R3729.zh: 该关系通过回归分析进行了定量评估。

R3741.en: The report quotes national census figures to illustrate the scale of population change.
R3741.zh: 该报告援引全国人口普查数据来说明人口变化的规模。

R3742.en: Dark urban surfaces absorb solar energy during the day and radiate heat after sunset.
R3742.zh: 深色的城市表面在白天吸收太阳能，日落后释放热量。

R3751.en: Researchers randomized participants into treatment and control groups to reduce selection bias.
R3751.zh: 研究人员将参与者随机分入治疗组和对照组，以减少选择偏倚。

R3754.en: Participants were randomly assigned to one of two groups.
R3754.zh: 参与者被随机分配到两个组中的一个。

R3760.en: The urban population expanded rapidly during the second half of the century.
R3760.zh: 本世纪下半叶，城市人口迅速增长。

R3762.en: Such extreme events rarely occur under stable climatic conditions.
R3762.zh: 在稳定的气候条件下，此类极端事件很少发生。

R3764.en: The evidence points to a gradual rather than sudden transition.
R3764.zh: 证据表明这是一种渐进而非突发的转变。

R3769.en: Plants react to changes in light by altering the orientation and growth of their leaves.
R3769.zh: 植物通过改变叶片的朝向和生长来应对光照变化。

R3775.en: The material readily absorbs moisture from the surrounding air.
R3775.zh: 这种材料很容易吸收周围空气中的水分。

R3783.en: Researchers gradually realized that the original model could not explain the full pattern in the data.
R3783.zh: 研究人员逐渐意识到，原有模型无法解释数据中的全部规律。

R3788.en: Authorities may need to reassess flood risk as sea levels continue to rise.
R3788.zh: 随着海平面持续上升，当局可能有必要重新评估洪水风险。

R3793.en: Participants were asked to recall what they had eaten during the previous 24 hours.
R3793.zh: 参与者被要求回忆自己在过去24小时内吃了什么。

R3794.en: The treatment group received the intervention for twelve weeks before the final assessment.
R3794.zh: 治疗组在最终评估之前接受了为期十二周的干预。

R3796.en: Researchers have recently reported similar results in several countries.
R3796.zh: 研究人员最近在多个国家报告了类似的结果。

R3806.en: The authors recognize that self-reported behaviour may differ from actual behaviour.
R3806.zh: 作者们承认，自我报告的行为可能与实际行为存在差异。

R3807.en: The review recommends further monitoring before the policy is expanded nationwide.
R3807.zh: 该综述建议在该政策全国推广之前进行进一步监测。

R3812.en: Scientists reconstructed past temperatures using evidence preserved in tree rings and ice cores.
R3812.zh: 科学家利用保存在树木年轮和冰芯中的证据重建了过去的温度。

R3816.en: Some ecosystems recover rapidly after disturbance, while others remain altered for decades.
R3816.zh: 一些生态系统在受到干扰后迅速恢复，另一些则在数十年内持续处于改变状态。

R3818.en: The study recruited participants from schools, workplaces and community organisations.
R3818.zh: 该研究从学校、工作场所和社区组织招募了参与者。

R3820.en: Seasonal water shortages recur each year when rainfall is below average.
R3820.zh: 当降雨量低于平均水平时，季节性缺水每年都会反复出现。

R3824.en: Tax and welfare policies can redistribute income between different social groups.
R3824.zh: 税收与福利政策可以在不同社会群体之间重新分配收入。

R3826.en: Improved insulation can reduce household energy use during cold weather.
R3826.zh: 改善保温隔热性能可以降低寒冷天气下的家庭能耗。

R3830.en: The term refers to a process in which resources are transferred between generations.
R3830.zh: 该术语指的是资源在不同世代之间转移的过程。

R3832.en: Researchers refined the model after comparing its predictions with newly collected data.
R3832.zh: 研究人员将模型预测与新收集的数据进行比较后，对模型作了改进。

R3834.en: The higher rate may reflect differences in access to preventive health care.
R3834.zh: 较高的比率可能反映了获得预防性医疗服务机会的差异。

R3841.en: Some forests can regenerate naturally once grazing pressure is reduced.
R3841.zh: 一旦放牧压力减轻，一些森林便能自然再生。

R3846.en: The sensor registered a sharp increase in temperature shortly after sunrise.
R3846.zh: 日出后不久，传感器便记录到温度的急剧上升。

R3850.en: Government agencies regulate water quality by setting and enforcing minimum standards.
R3850.zh: 政府机构通过制定并执行最低标准来监管水质。

R3852.en: The project aims to rehabilitate degraded wetlands by restoring natural water flows.
R3852.zh: 该项目旨在通过恢复自然水流来修复退化的湿地。

R3855.en: Repeated exposure to the same information can reinforce existing beliefs.
R3855.zh: 反复接触相同的信息会强化已有的信念。

R3859.en: Researchers rejected the original hypothesis after the predicted relationship failed to appear.
R3859.zh: 在预期的关联未能出现之后，研究人员否定了最初的假设。

R3861.en: The analysis relates changes in household income to differences in educational participation.
R3861.zh: 该分析将家庭收入的变化与教育参与的差异联系起来。

R3866.en: The effect remained relatively small despite the larger sample size.
R3866.zh: 尽管样本量更大，效应仍相对较小。

R3876.en: Many rural communities rely on groundwater during periods of low rainfall.
R3876.zh: 在降雨偏少的时期，许多农村社区依赖地下水。

R3877.en: Average mortality remained stable despite substantial changes in the age structure of the population.
R3877.zh: 尽管人口的年龄结构发生了重大变化，平均死亡率仍保持稳定。

R3883.en: Filtering can remove suspended particles before the water undergoes further treatment.
R3883.zh: 在水接受进一步处理之前，过滤可以去除悬浮颗粒。

R3887.en: Some governments provide incentives to renew ageing infrastructure with more efficient systems.
R3887.zh: 一些政府提供激励措施，用更高效的系统更新老旧的基础设施。

R3892.en: Many countries are gradually replacing coal-fired electricity with lower-carbon sources.
R3892.zh: 许多国家正逐步用低碳能源取代燃煤发电。

R3895.en: Independent teams were unable to replicate the unusually large effect reported in the original study.
R3895.zh: 独立团队未能重现原研究中报告的异常大的效应。

R3899.en: Participants from rural areas represented about one quarter of the final sample.
R3899.zh: 来自农村地区的参与者约占最终样本的四分之一。

R3904.en: The experiment was repeated to determine whether the original result could be reproduced.
R3904.zh: 实验被重复进行，以确定原结果能否重现。

R3909.en: Large infrastructure projects require substantial investment before any benefits are realized.
R3909.zh: 大型基础设施项目在产生任何效益之前都需要大量投资。

R3913.en: The newly discovered fossil closely resembles species found in neighbouring regions.
R3913.zh: 新发现的化石与邻近地区发现的物种十分相似。

R3923.en: Some crop varieties resist drought more effectively than conventional strains.
R3923.zh: 一些作物品种比传统品种更能耐受干旱。

R3927.en: Additional data are needed to resolve the disagreement between the two competing explanations.
R3927.zh: 需要更多数据来解决两种相互竞争的解释之间的分歧。

R3933.en: Participants responded more quickly when the visual signal was easier to distinguish.
R3933.zh: 当视觉信号更容易辨别时，参与者的反应更快。

R3940.en: Replanting native vegetation can restore soil stability and improve water retention.
R3940.zh: 重新种植本地植被可以恢复土壤稳定性并提高保水能力。

R3941.en: Water shortages may force authorities to restrict household consumption during dry periods.
R3941.zh: 在干旱时期，水资源短缺可能迫使当局限制家庭用水。

R3947.en: Dense urban materials retain heat after sunset and contribute to higher night-time temperatures.
R3947.zh: 致密的城市建筑材料在日落后仍留存热量，致使夜间气温升高。

R3951.en: Digital archives allow researchers to retrieve historical records quickly and systematically.
R3951.zh: 数字档案使研究人员能够快速、系统地检索历史记录。

R3956.en: Long-term monitoring revealed a gradual shift in the timing of seasonal migration.
R3956.zh: 长期监测揭示出季节性迁徙时间上的逐渐变化。

R3958.en: Early intervention can sometimes reverse a decline before it becomes permanent.
R3958.zh: 早期干预有时能在衰退变得不可逆转之前将其扭转。

R3961.en: Researchers revised their estimates after higher-quality population data became available.
R3961.zh: 在获得质量更高的人口数据之后，研究人员修订了原有的估计。

R3965.en: Low-cost genetic sequencing has revolutionized the study of biodiversity and disease transmission.
R3965.zh: 低成本基因测序彻底改变了生物多样性和疾病传播研究。

R3978.en: The study examines the role of role in explaining differences observed across populations.
R3978.zh: 该研究考察了某一因素在解释不同人群之间观察到的差异时所起的作用。

R3980.en: Roughly one quarter of the sample reported changing their travel habits.
R3980.zh: 约四分之一的样本报告称自己的出行习惯发生了变化。

R3988.en: Strong privacy rules can safeguard participants’ personal information during long-term research.
R3988.zh: 严格的隐私规则可以在长期研究过程中保护参与者的个人信息。

R4004.en: The report says that transport emissions are likely to rise unless travel behaviour changes.
R4004.zh: 报告指出，除非出行行为发生变化，否则交通排放量可能上升。

R4012.en: Strong winds scatter seeds over long distances and help some plants colonize new areas.
R4012.zh: 强风可将种子散布到很远的地方，帮助一些植物在新的区域扎根繁衍。

R4044.en: Researchers began to see a clear decline after the second year of monitoring.
R4044.zh: 监测进入第二年之后，研究人员开始观察到明显的下降。

R4045.en: The intervention seems to improve short-term outcomes, although the long-term effect remains uncertain.
R4045.zh: 该干预似乎能改善短期结果，但其长期效果仍不确定。

R4051.en: Researchers selected households from both urban and rural areas to improve the representativeness of the sample.
R4051.zh: 研究人员从城市和农村地区选取家庭，以提高样本的代表性。

R4088.en: Several studies have reported a similar relationship between sleep and memory.
R4088.zh: 多项研究报告了睡眠与记忆之间的类似关联。

R4089.en: The drought severely reduced crop yields across the region.
R4089.zh: 这场干旱严重降低了整个地区的农作物产量。

R4097.en: These results should be interpreted cautiously because the sample was not representative.
R4097.zh: 由于样本不具代表性，应谨慎解读这些结果。

R4098.en: The results show a steady increase in average household energy use over time.
R4098.zh: 结果显示，家庭平均能耗随时间稳步上升。

R4099.en: Glaciers are expected to shrink further if average temperatures continue to rise.
R4099.zh: 如果平均气温继续上升，冰川预计将进一步退缩。

R4106.en: Average scores increased significantly after the intervention.
R4106.zh: 干预之后，平均得分显著提高。

R4111.en: The two age groups responded similarly to the intervention.
R4111.zh: 两个年龄组对干预的反应相似。

R4112.en: The model simulates future flood risk under several different climate scenarios.
R4112.zh: 该模型模拟了若干不同气候情景下的未来洪水风险。

R4117.en: Temperature and humidity were recorded simultaneously throughout the experiment.
R4117.zh: 整个实验过程中，温度和湿度被同时记录。

R4118.en: Since the policy was introduced, average waiting times have fallen substantially.
R4118.zh: 自该政策实施以来，平均等候时间已大幅缩短。

R4130.en: The sample was small, so the findings should be interpreted with caution.
R4130.zh: 由于样本较小，应谨慎解读这些发现。

R4132.en: The results suggest that social factors may influence long-term social and environmental outcomes.
R4132.zh: 结果表明，社会因素可能对长期的社会和环境结果产生影响。

R4161.en: Improved infrastructure alone is unlikely to solve the wider problem of unequal access to services.
R4161.zh: 单靠改善基础设施不太可能解决服务获取不平等这一更广泛的问题。

R4164.en: Some species are more sensitive to temperature change than others.
R4164.zh: 一些物种对温度变化的敏感程度高于其他物种。

R4166.en: Something as simple as sleep duration can influence performance on memory tasks.
R4166.zh: 像睡眠时长这样简单的因素也会影响记忆任务的表现。

R4167.en: Participants sometimes changed their answers after receiving additional information.
R4167.zh: 参与者在获得额外信息后有时会更改自己的答案。

R4174.en: Some research centres specialize in monitoring infectious diseases and emerging pathogens.
R4174.zh: 一些研究中心专门从事传染病和新发病原体的监测。

R4178.en: The survey specifically examined attitudes toward public transport.
R4178.zh: 该调查专门考察了人们对公共交通的态度。

R4181.en: The protocol specifies the temperature at which all samples must be stored.
R4181.zh: 该方案明确规定了所有样品的储存温度。

R4188.en: Conservation measures helped stabilize the population after several years of decline.
R4188.zh: 在种群数量连续下降数年之后，保护措施使其趋于稳定。

R4196.en: Researchers standardized the measurement procedure so that results from different sites could be compared.
R4196.zh: 研究人员对测量程序作了标准化处理，以便对不同地点的结果进行比较。

R4204.en: The difference was statistically significant after adjustment for age.
R4204.zh: 经年龄校正后，该差异具有统计学意义。

R4209.en: Average life expectancy increased steadily over the study period.
R4209.zh: 研究期间，平均预期寿命稳步提高。

R4215.en: The association was still significant after income and age were taken into account.
R4215.zh: 在计入收入和年龄因素后，该关联仍然显著。

R4216.en: Moderate levels of exercise can stimulate physiological adaptations that improve cardiovascular fitness.
R4216.zh: 适度运动可以刺激生理适应，进而改善心血管健康。

R4229.en: Digital records can streamline administrative processes and reduce the time required to retrieve information.
R4229.zh: 数字记录能够简化行政流程，减少检索信息所需的时间。

R4242.en: The researchers subdivided the sample into four age groups for further analysis.
R4242.zh: 研究人员将样本细分为四个年龄组，以便作进一步分析。

R4249.en: Researchers must submit the study protocol for ethical review before collecting participant data.
R4249.zh: 研究人员必须在收集参与者数据之前将研究方案提交伦理审查。

R4252.en: The policy was introduced in 2018 and subsequently expanded nationwide.
R4252.zh: 该政策于2018年出台，随后在全国范围内推广。

R4254.en: Governments sometimes subsidize public transport to keep fares affordable for low-income households.
R4254.zh: 政府有时补贴公共交通，使低收入家庭也负担得起票价。

R4260.en: The new method substantially reduced processing time.
R4260.zh: 新方法大幅缩短了处理时间。

R4261.en: The available evidence is not sufficient to substantiate the claim that the policy caused the observed change.
R4261.zh: 现有证据不足以证实该政策导致了所观察到的变化这一说法。

R4272.en: Such changes are most common in regions experiencing rapid urban growth.
R4272.zh: 此类变化在经历快速城市增长的地区最为常见。

R4274.en: The sample was sufficiently large to detect a moderate effect.
R4274.zh: 样本量足够大，足以检测出中等程度的效应。

R4275.en: The final section summarizes the main findings and identifies areas requiring further research.
R4275.zh: 最后一节总结了主要发现，并指出了有待进一步研究的领域。

R4283.en: Digital imaging has largely superseded older photographic techniques in many areas of research.
R4283.zh: 数字成像已在许多研究领域很大程度上取代了较早的摄影技术。

R4292.en: Low oxygen levels can suppress microbial activity and slow the decomposition of organic matter.
R4292.zh: 低氧水平会抑制微生物活动，减缓有机物的分解。

R4298.en: Only a small proportion of seedlings survive prolonged periods of drought.
R4298.zh: 只有一小部分幼苗能在长期干旱中存活下来。

R4302.en: Authorities suspended fieldwork when severe flooding made the study area unsafe.
R4302.zh: 严重洪灾使研究区域不再安全，当局遂暂停了野外工作。

R4328.en: Systematic reviews synthesize evidence from multiple studies to identify consistent patterns.
R4328.zh: 系统综述综合多项研究的证据，以识别出一致的规律。

R4332.en: The researchers systematically reviewed all studies published during the previous two decades.
R4332.zh: 研究人员系统地回顾了此前二十年发表的所有研究。

R4338.en: Long-term policy is needed to tackle the structural causes of housing inequality.
R4338.zh: 解决住房不平等的结构性根源需要长期政策。

R4344.en: The analysis takes differences in age, income and education into account.
R4344.zh: 该分析将年龄、收入和教育方面的差异纳入了考虑。

R4380.en: Long-term records can tell researchers how rapidly environmental conditions have changed.
R4380.zh: 长期记录能让研究人员了解环境状况变化得有多快。

R4390.en: Larger cities tend to have higher housing costs and longer average commuting times.
R4390.zh: 较大的城市往往住房成本更高、平均通勤时间更长。

R4399.en: The trial was terminated early because the treatment produced unexpected adverse effects.
R4399.zh: 由于治疗产生了意料之外的不良反应，试验被提前终止。

R4419.en: The second group performed better than the first on all three measures.
R4419.zh: 第二组在所有三项指标上的表现都优于第一组。

R4421.en: The authors argue that early intervention can reduce long-term educational inequality.
R4421.zh: 作者们认为，早期干预可以减轻长期的教育不平等。

R4422.en: The results indicate a gradual decline rather than a sudden change.
R4422.zh: 结果表明这是一种渐进的下降，而非突然的变化。

R4425.en: Participants recorded their daily travel time for a period of two weeks.
R4425.zh: 参与者用两周时间记录了自己每天的出行时间。

R4426.en: Researchers asked them to complete the same task again six months later.
R4426.zh: 六个月后，研究人员请他们再次完成同一项任务。

R4428.en: Participants were asked to rate themselves before and after the training programme.
R4428.zh: 参与者被要求在培训项目前后对自己进行评分。

R4429.en: The samples were heated and then cooled to room temperature.
R4429.zh: 样品先被加热，随后冷却至室温。

R4438.en: There was no significant difference between the two groups at baseline.
R4438.zh: 基线时，两组之间没有显著差异。

R4440.en: The policy reduced travel time, thereby increasing access to employment.
R4440.zh: 该政策缩短了出行时间，从而增加了就业机会。

R4441.en: The sample was not representative; therefore, the findings should be interpreted cautiously.
R4441.zh: 样本不具代表性；因此，应谨慎解读这些发现。

R4449.en: These findings are consistent with evidence from earlier longitudinal studies.
R4449.zh: 这些发现与较早的纵向研究证据一致。

R4456.en: Many researchers think that social context plays an important role in shaping health behaviour.
R4456.zh: 许多研究人员认为，社会环境在塑造健康行为方面发挥着重要作用。

R4459.en: This pattern was observed in both urban and rural populations.
R4459.zh: 在城市和农村人群中均观察到了这一规律。

R4461.en: The samples were thoroughly cleaned before chemical analysis.
R4461.zh: 在进行化学分析之前，样品被彻底清洗干净。

R4462.en: The effect was small, though it remained statistically significant after adjustment.
R4462.zh: 该效应虽然较小，但在校正后仍具有统计学意义。

R4467.en: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying coastal habitats and the communities that depend on them.
R4467.zh: 海平面上升威胁着低洼的沿海栖息地以及依赖这些栖息地的社区。

R4469.en: Some species thrive in urban environments because food and shelter are readily available.
R4469.zh: 由于食物和栖身之所容易获得，一些物种在城市环境中繁衍兴旺。

R4470.en: Water moves through the soil more rapidly when large pores are present.
R4470.zh: 当存在大孔隙时，水在土壤中的流动会更快。

R4471.en: Temperature remained stable throughout the three-hour experiment.
R4471.zh: 在整个三小时的实验中，温度保持稳定。

R4473.en: The new method reduced measurement error and thus improved the reliability of the results.
R4473.zh: 新方法减少了测量误差，从而提高了结果的可靠性。

R4485.en: Taken together, the findings support a gradual rather than sudden change.
R4485.zh: 综合来看，这些发现支持渐变而非突变的观点。

R4488.en: Drought-resistant crops can tolerate lower levels of soil moisture than conventional varieties.
R4488.zh: 抗旱作物比传统品种更能耐受较低的土壤含水量。

R4492.en: Temperatures that are too high can reduce plant growth.
R4492.zh: 过高的温度会抑制植物生长。

R4505.en: Public policy gradually shifted toward greater investment in preventive health care.
R4505.zh: 公共政策逐渐转向加大对预防性保健的投入。

R4509.en: Chemical markers allow researchers to trace pollutants back to their original source.
R4509.zh: 化学标记物使研究人员能够将污染物追溯到其最初来源。

R4524.en: Participants were trained to use the monitoring equipment before field measurements began.
R4524.zh: 在野外测量开始之前，参与者接受了监测设备的使用培训。

R4538.en: Heat is transferred from warmer surfaces to cooler air through several physical processes.
R4538.zh: 热量通过若干物理过程从较暖的表面传递到较冷的空气中。

R4540.en: Digital technologies have transformed the way researchers collect, store and analyse data.
R4540.zh: 数字技术已经改变了研究人员收集、存储和分析数据的方式。

R4549.en: Scientific evidence does not always translate directly into changes in public policy.
R4549.zh: 科学证据并不总能直接转化为公共政策的变化。

R4556.en: Mosquitoes can transmit infectious diseases between human populations.
R4556.zh: 蚊子可以在不同人群之间传播传染病。

R4563.en: Rivers transport sediment from inland regions toward the coast.
R4563.zh: 河流将泥沙从内陆地区输送到海岸。

R4566.en: Airborne particles can travel hundreds of kilometres before settling on the ground.
R4566.zh: 空气中的颗粒物可飘行数百公里才落到地面。

R4567.en: The water was treated with ultraviolet light before being released from the facility.
R4567.zh: 水在从该设施排放之前接受了紫外线处理。

R4583.en: A sudden drop in temperature can trigger physiological changes in some plant species.
R4583.zh: 气温骤降会引发某些植物物种的生理变化。

R4616.en: These species typically reproduce during the wet season.
R4616.zh: 这些物种通常在雨季繁殖。

R4621.en: Ultimately, the success of the policy depends on whether it can be implemented consistently.
R4621.zh: 归根结底，该政策能否成功取决于其能否得到一以贯之的执行。

R4640.en: Under laboratory conditions, the material remained stable for several weeks.
R4640.zh: 在实验室条件下，该材料保持稳定达数周之久。

R4643.en: Short-term surveys may underestimate the full impact of chronic exposure to air pollution.
R4643.zh: 短期调查可能低估长期暴露于空气污染的整体影响。

R4644.en: The material undergoes a structural change when heated above a critical temperature.
R4644.zh: 加热到临界温度以上时，该材料会发生结构变化。

R4647.en: Differences in access to education may underlie part of the observed income gap.
R4647.zh: 受教育机会的差异可能是所观察到的收入差距的部分根源。

R4650.en: Poor enforcement can undermine otherwise well-designed environmental regulations.
R4650.zh: 执行不力会削弱本来设计良好的环境法规。

R4655.en: Researchers need long-term data to understand how ecosystems respond to gradual climate change.
R4655.zh: 研究人员需要长期数据来理解生态系统如何应对渐进的气候变化。

R4657.en: The research team undertook a large-scale survey of household energy use.
R4657.zh: 该研究团队开展了一项大规模的家庭能源使用调查。

R4662.en: The discovery undoubtedly influenced later research in the field.
R4662.zh: 这一发现无疑影响了该领域后来的研究。

R4673.en: A common classification system can unify data collected by different research teams.
R4673.zh: 统一的分类体系可以整合不同研究团队收集的数据。

R4680.en: Shared environmental goals can unite communities that otherwise have different economic interests.
R4680.zh: 共同的环境目标能够把经济利益本不相同的社区团结起来。

R4686.en: Unlike the control group, participants receiving the intervention improved over time.
R4686.zh: 与对照组不同，接受干预的参与者随时间推移有所改善。

R4698.en: The effect remained stable until the temperature exceeded 40 degrees Celsius.
R4698.zh: 在温度超过40摄氏度之前，该效应一直保持稳定。

R4701.en: As temperatures went up, the rate of evaporation also increased.
R4701.zh: 随着气温上升，蒸发速率也随之加快。

R4702.en: Researchers update the model whenever new population estimates become available.
R4702.zh: 每当有新的人口估计数据可用，研究人员就会更新模型。

R4706.en: Upon exposure to light, the compound begins to break down rapidly.
R4706.zh: 一旦暴露于光照，该化合物便开始迅速分解。

R4715.en: Public health experts urge governments to reduce exposure to preventable environmental risks.
R4715.zh: 公共卫生专家敦促各国政府降低民众接触可预防环境风险的机会。

R4720.en: The study uses satellite imagery to estimate changes in forest cover.
R4720.zh: 该研究利用卫星图像估算森林覆盖的变化。

R4726.en: The process usually takes several days under laboratory conditions.
R4726.zh: 在实验室条件下，该过程通常需要数天时间。

R4729.en: Some rural clinics utilize mobile technology to reach patients living far from major hospitals.
R4729.zh: 一些农村诊所利用移动技术服务那些居住地远离大医院的患者。

R4736.en: Public health programmes aim to vaccinate vulnerable groups before seasonal infection rates rise.
R4736.zh: 公共卫生项目旨在赶在季节性感染率上升之前为易感人群接种疫苗。

R4744.en: Researchers validated the model using an independent dataset collected in another region.
R4744.zh: 研究人员利用在另一地区收集的独立数据集验证了该模型。

R4759.en: Average household energy use varies considerably by income, climate and building type.
R4759.zh: 家庭平均能耗随收入、气候和建筑类型的不同而有很大差异。

R4777.en: Independent measurements were used to verify the accuracy of the original estimates.
R4777.zh: 独立测量数据被用来核实最初估计的准确性。

R4787.en: The two groups showed very similar patterns of response.
R4787.zh: 两组表现出非常相似的反应模式。

R4800.en: Companies that violate environmental standards may face substantial financial penalties.
R4800.zh: 违反环境标准的公司可能面临巨额经济处罚。

R4808.en: The two groups were virtually identical at baseline.
R4808.zh: 基线时，两组几乎完全相同。

R4820.en: Researchers use maps and graphs to visualize spatial patterns in disease incidence.
R4820.zh: 研究人员利用地图和图表直观呈现疾病发病率的空间分布规律。

R4850.en: Many households want to reduce energy costs but lack the capital required for major improvements.
R4850.zh: 许多家庭希望降低能源成本，但缺乏进行重大改造所需的资金。

R4854.en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could push several species toward extinction.
R4854.zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地的持续丧失可能把若干物种推向灭绝。

R4856.en: The unexpected difference was large enough to warrant further investigation.
R4856.zh: 这一出人意料的差异足够大，有必要作进一步调查。

R4878.en: Repeated drought can weaken trees and make them more vulnerable to disease.
R4878.zh: 反复干旱会削弱树木，使其更容易染病。

R4890.en: Policy makers must weigh the economic benefits of development against potential environmental damage.
R4890.zh: 决策者必须在发展的经济效益与潜在的环境损害之间进行权衡。

R4894.en: The model performed well when applied to an independent dataset.
R4894.zh: 该模型应用于独立数据集时表现良好。

R4904.en: The study examines what happens when access to public transport improves.
R4904.zh: 该研究考察了公共交通的可及性提高时会出现什么情况。

R4905.en: The researchers recorded when each participant first showed signs of improvement.
R4905.zh: 研究人员记录了每位参与者首次出现改善迹象的时间。

R4906.en: The effect was strongest in regions where access to clean water remained limited.
R4906.zh: 在清洁水供应仍然有限的地区，该效应最强。

R4907.en: Urban populations increased rapidly, whereas rural populations remained relatively stable.
R4907.zh: 城市人口迅速增长，而农村人口保持相对稳定。

R4908.en: The authors describe a process whereby repeated exposure leads to long-term adaptation.
R4908.zh: 作者们描述了一个过程，在这一过程中，反复接触会导致长期适应。

R4910.en: The study examined whether early exposure influenced later language development.
R4910.zh: 该研究考察了早期接触是否会影响日后的语言发展。

R4911.en: The device, which records temperature every minute, was calibrated before use.
R4911.zh: 该设备每分钟记录一次温度，并在使用前经过了校准。

R4912.en: While overall mortality declined, the gap between income groups remained substantial.
R4912.zh: 尽管总体死亡率有所下降，但不同收入群体之间的差距仍然很大。

R4914.en: Participants who completed the training made fewer errors in the final assessment.
R4914.zh: 完成培训的参与者在最终评估中出现的错误更少。

R4917.en: The researchers attempted to explain why the two populations responded differently to the same environmental pressure.
R4917.zh: 研究人员试图解释为何两个种群对同样的环境压力反应不同。

R4919.en: The method is widely used in environmental research.
R4919.zh: 该方法在环境研究中得到广泛应用。

R4920.en: Unequal access to digital technology can widen existing educational inequalities.
R4920.zh: 数字技术获取机会的不平等会加剧既有的教育不平等。

R4927.en: Future research will need to examine whether the same pattern occurs in other populations.
R4927.zh: 未来的研究将需要考察其他人群中是否也会出现同样的规律。

R4938.en: The treatment was associated with a modest improvement in average test scores.
R4938.zh: 该治疗与平均考试成绩的适度提高相关。

R4939.en: Participants were free to withdraw from the study at any time.
R4939.zh: 参与者可以随时自由退出研究。

R4941.en: Within five years, the number of households with internet access had doubled.
R4941.zh: 五年之内，接入互联网的家庭数量翻了一番。

R4944.en: Without reliable baseline data, it is difficult to measure the true size of the change.
R4944.zh: 没有可靠的基线数据，就难以衡量这一变化的真实幅度。

R4945.en: The material can withstand high temperatures without losing structural strength.
R4945.zh: 这种材料能够承受高温而不丧失结构强度。

R4965.en: A larger sample would provide a more precise estimate of the effect.
R4965.zh: 更大的样本将提供对效应更精确的估计。

R4966.en: Researchers wrote a detailed report describing the methods, results and limitations of the study.
R4966.zh: 研究人员撰写了一份详细的报告，描述了研究的方法、结果和局限。

R4969.en: Written records provide important evidence about how social institutions changed over time.
R4969.zh: 书面记录为研究社会制度如何随时间演变提供了重要证据。

R4984.en: The second experiment yielded results that were consistent with the original findings.
R4984.zh: 第二次实验得出的结果与最初的发现一致。

R0178.en: After the samples were collected, they were stored at a constant temperature.
R0178.zh: 样本采集完成后，被存放在恒定温度下。

R3275.en: Once the samples were collected, they were stored at a constant temperature.
R3275.zh: 样本一经采集，就被存放在恒定温度下。

R0180.en: Participants completed a questionnaire immediately after the task and were interviewed afterward.
R0180.zh: 参与者在任务结束后立即完成了问卷，随后接受了访谈。

R0181.en: Participants completed a questionnaire immediately after the task and were interviewed afterwards.
R0181.zh: 参与者在任务结束后立即完成了问卷，之后接受了访谈。
